title: Trust no cookie
prompt: The server trusts a cookie the browser controls. What does it contain, and what is behind the admin panel?
hint.1: Decode the session cookie. It is not encrypted.
hint.2: The admin panel hides an encoded flag in the response too. Decode it.
hint.3: The server should never trust role from the client. Decode the flag text.
walkthrough: Decode the flag text in the response.
